name: @argentic/chest-mcp
description: The MCP server that lets an assistant work on a Chest with a member's personal access token: tools, logs, database, variables, catalogue and GitHub, every write confirmed by a human.
author: Argentic

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'build']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})"
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test build/test/*.test.js
